source.snippet: I would pay for such content. Do you have course notes? Have you written a book? I'd pay to get expert knowledge from... an expert! LLMs are fine, but still not replacing actual human experts IME.

problem_statement: Developers learning modern front-end web development cannot get reliable, expert-curated educational content; LLM-generated material is seen as insufficient and they explicitly express willingness to pay for structured expert knowledge.
target_segment: Mid-career software developers and front-end engineers upskilling on modern web frameworks and tooling
notes: Single HN comment but with explicit 'I'd pay' language, recent (Sep 2026). Buyer: individual developer willing to pay for a book or course. WTP evidence: unprompted offer to pay, mentions looking for course notes or a book. Competes with generic LLM output; niche is expert-curated, opinionated frontend content. Weak due to single signal but buyer intent is unambiguous.
